analogy.rationale: AMPK activators act largely through PRKAA1 and KCNJ8 (a KATP channel subunit), so the closest transcriptional analogs are other KATP/potassium-channel modulators; downstream metabolic effects overlap weakly with insulin sensitizers and mTOR/PI3K pathway inhibitors, but in these cell lines the response is expected to be weak.
